name: Memento Dears
source:
Melodie Adams has not always had the best of luck. However, recently things seem to be turning around for her.
She's pretty sure that she is in love with someone and that they feel the same way about her.
But just as everything starts to line up, something big happens. A terrible accident leaves her right back at the beginning.
Now, with a major hindrance derailing her, will she get back on course? ...Or find a new path?

[From [url=https://otome-palace.itch.io/memento-dears]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
梅洛迪·亚当斯的运气并不总是那么好。不过，最近她的情况似乎出现了转机。
她非常确定自己爱上了某人，并且他们对她也有同样的感觉。
但就在一切开始步入正轨时，发生了一件大事。一场可怕的事故让她回到了起点。
现在，她遇到了重大障碍，她能回到正轨吗？……或者寻找新的道路？

[来自[url=https://otome-palace.itch.io/memento-dears]Itch.io[/url]]
